name: notipet
description: Rings your Windows desktop when a Codex turn finishes or waits for your approval, and lets Codex alert you itself. Needs the notipet tray app.

interface.shortDescription: A sound and a pop-up when Codex needs you
interface.longDescription: Hooks that ring when a turn finishes (Stop) or waits for approval (PermissionRequest) and stop what is over when you answer (UserPromptSubmit), plus a skill so Codex can alert you - and stop its own alarm - when it needs a decision, is blocked, or finished a long task. Windows only; install the notipet app from GitHub Releases first.
defaultPrompt: Alert me through notipet when this task is done
